rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when preservation means shielding something from damage or harm.

example.english: This painting needs careful preservation; don't let the sunlight damage it.
example.traditional: 呢幅畫要小心保護，唔好畀陽光曬壞。
example.jyutping: ni1 fuk1 waa2 jiu3 siu2 sam1 bou2 wu6 m4 hou2 bei2 joeng4 gwong1 saai3 waai6

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on keeping an object, record, or resource intact rather than actively protecting it.

example.english: I am responsible for the preservation of this document.
example.jyutping: ngo5 fu6 zaak3 bou2 cyun4 ni1 fan6 man4 gin6

rows.note: Use this for the condition in which an object has been preserved, especially in descriptions or assessments.

example.english: This artifact is in a very good state of preservation.
example.traditional: 呢件文物嘅保存狀況相當理想。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 man4 mat6 ge3 bou2 cyun4 zong6 fong3 soeng1 dong1 lei5 soeng2
